# ATLAS File Studio Plugin ID: `atlas.plugin.file-studio` Version: `0.1.16` ATLAS File Studio prepares a scoped Home Assistant file editor: - file tree - editor surface - image preview for PNG, JPG/JPEG, SVG, GIF, WebP, BMP and ICO - syntax highlighting - YAML validation - upload and download - `/config` as default root - `/addons` only after Administration approval - no free root access by default
